bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 受阻于 $535.6 下方

read.en: Microsoft slipped 0.1% on Oct 28 to $531.01, trading between $526.14 and $534.57. It is just above the falling 5-day ($528.11) and 10-day ($530.74) averages and above the rising 30-day ($521.16), 100-day ($463.15) and 200-day ($437.32). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19, above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($542.47), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: 微软 10月28日下跌 0.1%，收于 $531.01，盘中区间 $526.14–534.57。股价略高于下行的 5 日（$528.11）和 10 日均线（$530.74），并位于上行的 30 日（$521.16）、100 日（$463.15）和 200 日均线（$437.32）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方、零轴之上，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$542.47），RSI 为 56。

read.en: No level changed: the close held the 5 and 10-day and the $534.6 high again stopped below the $535.6 Oct 19 high. Resistance is $534.6–535.6, then $542.5–543.8 (SAR, Oct 16 high) and $551–554. Support is $526–531 (5 and 10-day, Oct 28 low), then $515.7–521.2 (Oct 23 low, 30-day) and $497–502. A close above $535.6 would target $543; a close below $515.7 would open $497–502.
